body_html:
The Ormos Mini Action Camera redefines portability and versatility in a camera so small, it fits on your thumb. Weighing just 1.23oz (≈35g) and featuring a revolutionary 180° rotatable lens and strong magnetic mount, this 2.7K camera lets you capture life from any angle, anywhere. Whether you're hiking, cycling, skiing, or just documenting your day, this tiny powerhouse delivers stunning clarity and ultimate convenience.

Key Features:

  • 2.7K Ultra HD Video: Record crisp, vibrant video with exceptional detail, perfect for sharing and preserving your adventures.

  • Thumb-Sized & Ultra-Light: At only 1.23oz and roughly the size of your thumb, it’s the most portable action camera you’ll ever own. Carry it anywhere without feeling a burden.

  • 180° Rotating Lens: Freely rotate the lens to find the perfect framing for every shot—no more awkward camera positioning.

  • Magnetic Mounting System: The built-in strong magnet allows you to securely attach the camera to metal surfaces like bikes, helmets, tripods, or fridges for hands-free recording.

  • WiFi & APP Control: Connect seamlessly to your smartphone via WiFi. Use the dedicated app to control the camera, preview footage, and transfer files instantly.

  • Compact & Discreet Design: Its small size makes it ideal for first-person POV shots and situations where a traditional camera would be intrusive.

  • Simple One-Button Operation: Easy to use, allowing you to focus on the moment rather than complicated settings.
